Read: `.github/prompts/PHASE2.md`, `src/domain/ledger.ts`, `src/domain/query.ts`, `src/adapters/file-ledger.ts`, `src/ui/LocalApp.tsx`, `src/ui/views/ReviewView.tsx`, `src/ui/views/SpendForm.tsx`, `tests/ledger.test.ts`.Create: `src/domain/rules.ts`, `src/ui/views/RulesView.tsx`. ## Build
1. `file-ledger.ts`, optional `rules`.   - Each rule: `id`, `name`, `order`, `enabled`, and `match`.     - `match`: `text`, `mode` (`contains | startsWith`, ignoring case), `accountId` (or null), `sign` (`out | in | any`), `minCents` and `maxCents` (or null).   - `action`: `displayName` (or null), `categoryId` (or null), `split` (a batch 14 preset, or null), and `tags`.   - Also `autoConfirm` (false) and `updatedAt`.   - An entry gets optional `source` (`manual | bank | splitwise | rule | memory | history`), `ruleId`, and `displayName`, copied from the rule when the entry is created. Old entries keep no `source`. Readers use the origin rule in `PHASE2.md`.   - In Review only, set `source` on new entries: `bank`, then `rule` or `memory` when one filled the row. Other views stay unchanged.   - `query.ts`: the `source` filter uses a stored `source` first, then the origin rule. `rule`, `memory`, and `history` count as `bank` for that filter.2. `rules.ts`.   - `firstRule(rules, row, account)` takes enabled rules by `order` and returns the first match.   - `autoConfirm` works only when the rule has a split.   - Rules are checked before category memory. Memory applies only when no rule matches.3. `ReviewView.tsx`.   - A matched row shows "By rule: name" and comes prefilled from the action.   - "Apply N auto rules" creates entries for matched rows with `autoConfirm`, with `source: "rule"` and `ruleId`.   - "Create rule from this row" opens `RulesView` with the description filled in.   - A display name shows beside the raw description in Review and Activity.4. `RulesView.tsx`.   - List the rules in order, with move up and down, enable, edit, and delete.   - While editing, preview the matching review rows: the count and the first 10.   - "Undo rule entries" removes the entries with that `ruleId` and clears their rows' `entryId`, after a confirm. Add Rules to the nav.
## Tests
One test: two rules match one row, and the lower `order` wins. A rule with `autoConfirm` and no split is not auto-confirmed.
## Done when
`npm test` and `npm run typecheck` pass. Update `PROGRESS.md`. Next is 16.
